description_en: Adds an object to a scenario-specific custom policy for protection
description_zh: 为定制场景策略添加防护对象
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo attach-scene-defense-object --policy-id 321a-fd31-df51-0000 --object-type Domain --objects www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachSceneDefenseObject
